name: copeland_catalogue_correlation
title: ARI/Copeland catalogue polynomial for scroll compressors (function library)
summary: FUNCTION copeland_ari(table$, coef$, T_ev, T_cd): ARI 10-coefficient third-order polynomial of a Copeland ZH scroll compressor catalogue (power W, mass flow M, swept volume Vs), with the five catalogue tables recovered from the source file; the compressor correlation of the Vitocal 300-G heat pump model CSL-0116.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file for the property states (T_ev, T_cd, T_su_cp, v_su_cp within 0.03 %, h_su_cp shifted by the 148.16 kJ/kg R134a reference-state offset) and exactness self-checks for the function (W_err = 0; M polynomial recomputed in Python from the shipped tables). The catalogue-dependent outputs are not comparable: the stored run used an older external version of the ZH38K4E-TFD table (Vs = 82.61 cm^3, factor 3-4 in W) that is absent from the collection. Comparison run on the native file; it equals the former _coolsolve variant on all 13 variables.
verification.notes: Native file (lookup(table$, i+1, coef$) in a FUNCTION) now run and compared, with CoolSolve fix/library-gaps-2 (CS-BUG-LOOKUP-COL-ARG and CS-GAP-LOOKUP-PROC closed): the .sol equals the one of the former variant on the 13 variables (max relative difference 2e-12, h_su_cp). compare_solution.py: 12 common variables, 7 differ (rtol=0.001): T_ev rel. diff 2.9e-2 as printed (0.019 K absolute on a 0.65 C saturation temperature), T_su_cp 3.4e-3 (same cause); h_su_cp differs by the documented reference-state offset; W_dot/M_dot/Vs/epsilon_v differ by the documented catalogue vintage. Status runs, not verified: the function results (the purpose of the model) have no independent reference because the table of the stored run is lost; only the property states and the exactness of the polynomial are checked.
